intro:
Constructs new string stream.

Given

base_type as std::basic_iostream<CharT, Traits>, and
 buf_type as std::basic_stringbuf<CharT, Traits, Allocator>,

the std::basic_iostream base and the exposition-only data member sb are initialized as follows.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
str

 -

 string to use as initial contents of the string stream


 t

 -

 an object (convertible to std::basic_string_view) to use as initial contents of the string stream


 a

 -

 allocator used for allocating the contents of the string stream


 mode

 -

 specifies stream open mode. It is a BitmaskType, the following constants are defined:



 Constant

 Explanation




 app

 seek to the end of stream before each write




 binary

 open in binary mode




 in

 open for reading




 out

 open for writing




 trunc

 discard the contents of the stream when opening




 ate

 seek to the end of stream immediately after open




 noreplace (C++23)

 open in exclusive mode





 other

 -

 another string stream to use as source

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
Construction of one-off basic_stringstream objects in a tight loop, such as when used for string conversion, may be significantly more costly than calling str() to reuse the same object.
